name: Tidegate
summary: The eastern inspection gate where canal cargo enters Veyr under watch, quotas, and damp morning light.
sensory_cues: ink dust pasted to damp wood
clerks calling seal counts over the tide bells
constraints: Every satchel can be opened under tithe law.
Brine glass lamps reveal tampered wax if inspectors have time to use them.
Flood tunnel grates are chained above waist height at dawn.
